sections.description_of_the_ingredient:
1. Makoy (Solanum Nigrum) 
 It is known for its bitter taste and anushna (Not hot) potency, and contains active alkaloids like solanine, solamargine, and solasonine that give it powerful medicinal effects. It works by reducing inflammation and internal heat, purifying the blood, and supporting liver health, making it effective in treating liver disorders (Yakrit Vikara) and jaundice (Kamala). Its digestive and mild laxative properties help relieve abdominal disorders (Udar Roga), while its blood-purifying action improves anemia (Pandu). Additionally, Makoy’s anti-inflammatory and venotonic effects soothe piles (Bavasir), reduce swelling (Shotha), and its antipyretic properties assist in lowering fever (Jwara), providing a comprehensive natural remedy for these conditions. 
 Method of Preparation 

 Take 1 part of Makoy seeds 
 Soak it overnight in 10 parts of clean water 
 On the next morning, transfer the soaked mixture into an Arka Yantra (traditional distillation apparatus) 
 Perform distillation and collect 20 bottles of Ark from the process 
 Store in a clean, dry, and airtight glass container 

 Medicinal Properties 

 Supports liver health by reducing inflammation and balancing Pitta dosha, helping manage liver disorders and jaundice 
 Reduces swelling and cleanses the blood, beneficial in conditions like piles, anemia, and systemic inflammations 
 Enhances digestion and helps reduce fever, making it useful in abdominal disorders and febrile conditions

 Introduction

Makoy Ark is particularly useful in managing liver disorders (Yakrit Vikara), fevers (Jwara), and digestive conditions (Udar Roga). 
 Ingredient 
 
 Makoy (Solanum nigrum) – Seed 
 
 Description of the Ingredient 
 1. Makoy (Solanum Nigrum) 
 It is known for its bitter taste and anushna (Not hot) potency, and contains active alkaloids like solanine, solamargine, and solasonine that give it powerful medicinal effects. It works by reducing inflammation and internal heat, purifying the blood, and supporting liver health, making it effective in treating liver disorders (Yakrit Vikara) and jaundice (Kamala). Its digestive and mild laxative properties help relieve abdominal disorders (Udar Roga), while its blood-purifying action improves anemia (Pandu). Additionally, Makoy’s anti-inflammatory and venotonic effects soothe piles (Bavasir), reduce swelling (Shotha), and its antipyretic properties assist in lowering fever (Jwara), providing a comprehensive natural remedy for these conditions. 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take 1 part of Makoy seeds 
 Soak it overnight in 10 parts of clean water 
 On the next morning, transfer the soaked mixture into an Arka Yantra (traditional distillation apparatus) 
 Perform distillation and collect 20 bottles of Ark from the process 
 Store in a clean, dry, and airtight glass container 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 
 Supports liver health by reducing inflammation and balancing Pitta dosha, helping manage liver disorders and jaundice 
 Reduces swelling and cleanses the blood, beneficial in conditions like piles, anemia, and systemic inflammations 
 Enhances digestion and helps reduce fever, making it useful in abdominal disorders and febrile conditions 
 
 Indications 
 
 Piles (Bavasir) 
 Abdominal disorders (Udar Roga) 
 Liver disorders (Yakrit Vikara) 
 Anemia (Pandu) 
 Jaundice (Kamla) 
 Inflammation (Shotha) 
 Fever (Jwara) 
 
 Dosage 
 2 tola – 10 tola (23.32 – 116.63 grams) 
 Contraindications 
 
 This herbal formulation does not have any side effects. 
 Pregnant women, breastfeeding women, and children below 5 years should consult a healthcare provider before using this herbal formulation. 
 
 Conclusion 
 Makoy Ark is a time-tested Ayurvedic formulation that naturally supports liver function, improves digestion, and helps purify the blood. Its anushna (Not hot) and anti-inflammatory nature makes it suitable for a wide range of Pitta-related disorders, including jaundice, piles, anemia, and chronic fevers. When prepared and administered correctly, this classical remedy serves as a gentle yet effective tool for internal detoxification and metabolic balance.
